metrics.ttft_mean_ms: Mean request first-token latency, then arithmetic mean over completed batches. Includes admission, scheduling, prefill and first-token production.
metrics.steady_state_output_tokens_per_s: Aggregate output rate from last request first-token arrival to first request completion, using token-count interpolation.

comparison_note: New matched two-node allocation; use this NCCL baseline, not the earlier allocation.
decision: All performance candidates reverted: no candidate established ordinary 32-request TTFT non-regression alongside the Decode gain. Retained code only fixes receive-count ownership.
profile_scope: Separate diagnostic runs. Values are per-kernel means per rank, then averaged across ranks; not summed across GPUs or equated with HTTP latency. Prefill batch shapes can differ.
matched_admission_scope: Private diagnostic with matched request membership and actual local token shapes; warm repeat zero excluded. Release-to-first-token is not normal HTTP TTFT. Real model routing is used.
limitations: Synthetic token prompts with real model routing; not a model accuracy evaluation.
Three NCCL samples; original and active-QP both have six samples across two independent server starts; other candidates have three samples.
